# Reed Creative Labs

> Reed Creative Labs is a veteran-founded, family-built creative technology and software development studio in South Carolina, serving US clients nationwide. Commercial services include business websites, front-end applications, practical automation, agency implementation, and technical visualization. Original games and software remain a separate studio division.

Forgefield is RCL’s current flagship for Windows, available now on Steam and itch.io, with its Steam release on October 19, 2026. See its product page for the current launch date, price, and availability. Archived projects are retained as R&D or historical work, not upcoming releases or active commercial commitments. Other projects are brief catalog references without dedicated product pages.

The public website is a static Next.js App Router application built with React and TypeScript. Its signature black-hole visualization uses a modern Fortran state system compiled to WebAssembly, with browser lifecycle and rendering. Product media consists of native captures, not generated promotional art.

## Hire RCL
- [Services](https://reedcreativelabs.com/services): Core offers, initial planning ranges, scope boundaries, and delivery process.
- [Agency Partners](https://reedcreativelabs.com/agency-partners): White-label front-end implementation and scoped technical collaboration nationwide.
- [Work](https://reedcreativelabs.com/work): Client work, original products, and internal demonstrations, clearly categorized.
- [Start a Project](https://reedcreativelabs.com/contact): Prepare an email inquiry locally or contact the studio directly; the page does not send messages.
- [Science Lab](https://reedcreativelabs.com/science-lab): Technical context for RCL simulation and rendering demonstrations, not a released standalone product.

## Primary Product

- [Forgefield](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/forgefield): RCL's flagship generative particle simulation for Windows 11 x64, with nine native-rendered worlds and live wallpaper/screensaver playback. Current availability, the official itch.io and Steam links, and the optional YouTube trailer are maintained on the product page.

## Upcoming collection

- [Phase Arcade](https://reedcreativelabs.com/projects/phase-arcade-volume-1): An upcoming collection featuring Phase Breaker, Phase Shift, and Phase Court. Windows release targeted for late October 2026. Android and iOS versions are planned afterward.

## Selected R&D

- [Project Load Bearing](https://reedcreativelabs.com/products#project-load-bearing): Archived structural construction-and-testing prototype connecting Unreal Engine to a native Fortran static frame solver. Technical R&D, not certified engineering software.
- [Static Drift](https://reedcreativelabs.com/products#static-drift): Archived procedural ambient Android TV prototype with native rendering and remote controls. Not an upcoming store release.

## More from RCL

- [Products and Selected R&D](https://reedcreativelabs.com/products): Forgefield, Phase Arcade, secondary mobile projects, selected archived prototypes, and historical project records.

## Services

- [Studio Services](https://reedcreativelabs.com/services): Premium websites and focused custom software for small businesses, organizations, professionals, and independent creators.
